name: zidoo-wav
note: A network player over SMB on a 4-thread Atom NAS (#456) starting a 6-channel WAV track: a probe handle, then the playing handle, while it re-reads the heads and tails of the album's other DSF and WAV files. The trace's own rate and lead are those of a CPU too slow for it; rate 3.5 and lead 4 s are the player's demand as modelled for #508.
